definitions.gloss: hiding; lying low; going into concealment
definitions.explanation: The act of hiding oneself or remaining concealed, especially to avoid detection by authorities.
A period during which a disease or condition is present but not yet showing symptoms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山中|さんちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜伏|せんぷく}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The criminal was hiding in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{潜伏|せんぷく}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}き{止|と}めた→突き止める：09344_tsukitomeru⟧。
examples.english: The police tracked down the hideout.

examples.japanese: {数年間|すうねんかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{潜伏|せんぷく}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A suspect who had been hiding in the country for several years was arrested.

examples.english: The incubation period is about two weeks.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ウイルス→ウイルス：05223_uirusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{潜伏|せんぷく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: This virus has a long latency period.

examples.english: Because the incubation period is long, one may not notice the infection.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {潜|せん} (to hide, to lurk) + {伏|ふく} (to lie face down, to crouch). Used as a suru verb ({潜伏|せんぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Sense 1 relates to criminals or fugitives hiding; sense 2 is used in medical contexts for the incubation period of diseases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潜伏|せんぷく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (incubation period / period of hiding)
- {潜伏|せんぷく}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (hideout, place of concealment)
- {潜伏|せんぷく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to go into hiding)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隠|かく}れる→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧: to hide — the everyday word for hiding
- ⟦{逃亡|とうぼう}→逃亡：14367_toubou⟧: flight, escape — fleeing rather than hiding in place
